title: Gorgeous clock, can't read the time
text: Gorgeous clock, can't read the time. I love the look of this clock, it is really big and hangs nicely. However, don't expect to be able to read the time! The hands are black on a dark background, no one in my house can tell the time from this clock. We love the clock so we will keep it. We even tried to paint the hands a lighter color, but it didn't help. It's a great decorative piece, just be aware that telling time won't be easy!
